notConfigured.heading: Team server not connected
notConfigured.body: This build has no Supabase configuration, so only personal features (chat, memory) are available. An admin needs to set VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY at build time.

signIn.heading: Sign in to work with your team
signIn.body: Sign in with your GitHub account. Your browser will open the sign-in page; come back to the app when done.
signIn.waiting: Waiting for you to sign in in the browser…

onboard.heading: You are not in a team yet

leave.title: Leave “{{team}}”
leave.simple: You will no longer see this team's projects and tasks. You need a new invite to rejoin.
leave.successorBody: You are the only Owner. Choose who becomes Owner before you leave.
leave.soloBody: You are the last member of this team. What should happen to it?
leave.keep: Keep the team and its data
leave.keepHint: You get a code valid for 30 days. The first person to join with it (you or whoever you send it to) becomes Owner.
leave.deleteHint: Deletes all of the team's projects, tasks, comments, feedback and invites. This cannot be undone.
leave.confirmName: Type the team name “{{team}}” to confirm

recovery.title: You left “{{team}}”
recovery.body: The team was kept. Save this code to rejoin or hand it to someone who will take over (valid for 30 days). The first person to use it becomes Owner.

invites.heading: Invites
invites.byEmail: Email (empty = share code anyone can use for 7 days)
invites.hint: Send the code to the invitee: they sign in to Team Working with GitHub and enter it on the Team screen.

profile.heading: My team profile
profile.skills: Skills (comma separated) — used by the assistant to suggest assignments

errors.invite_invalid: The invite code is wrong or expired.
errors.invite_email_mismatch: This invite is for a different email.
errors.last_owner: A team needs at least one Owner. Transfer ownership first.
errors.successor_invalid: The new Owner must be another member of the team.
errors.team_not_empty: The team still has other members, so it cannot be deleted.
errors.not_member: You are no longer a member of this team.
errors.not_allowed: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.network_error: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.port_in_use: Port 47823 is used by another app. Close it and try again.
errors.timeout: Sign-in timed out. Please try again.
